quote: We consider the case of multi‑class classification with samples {(x, y), x ∈ X , y ∈ Y, i = 1, 2, ..., N }, e.g., sentences, and the number of classes is K.
The performance metrics follow GLUE and are reported for classification tasks such as CoLA, MNLI, MRPC, etc.
We evaluate our proposed approach to the classification tasks on the GLUE benchmark.
All evaluations are performed on standard GLUE benchmark dev and test sets without human annotation of generated text.
